rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when frustration comes with irritation or anger.

example.english: I’m really frustrated; the computer froze again.
example.traditional: 我真係激氣，部電腦又死機喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 gik1 hei3 bou6 din6 nou5 jau6 sei2 gei1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the person feels frustrated because they cannot change or control the situation.

example.english: I can’t control this situation, so I’m really frustrated.
example.traditional: 件事唔係我控制到，我都好無奈。
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 m4 hai6 ngo5 hung3 zai3 dou2 ngo5 dou1 hou2 mou4 noi6

rows.note: Use this when someone feels defeated or thwarted, especially after an attempt or plan fails.

example.english: I’ve tried for so long and still can’t get it done, and I feel really frustrated.
example.traditional: 我試咗咁耐都整唔到，真係好挫敗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 si3 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 zing2 m4 dou2 zan1 hai6 hou2 co3 baai6

rows.note: Use this when the frustration is specifically disappointment that an outcome did not meet expectations.

example.english: I’m really frustrated that I got such a low score on this exam.
example.traditional: 今次考試得咁少分，我真係好失望。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 dak1 gam3 siu2 fan1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6
